Dave Filoni is employed by the British Broadcasting Corporation. Narendra Modi was also listed as the director of the British Broadcasting Corporation.

nodes.name: The Brady Bunch
nodes.summary: The original broadcaster of The Brady Bunch is American Broadcasting Company.

nodes.name: Channel 4
nodes.summary: The headquarters of Channel 4 is located in London. Channel 4 was the original broadcaster of the television program Girl Meets World. The headquarters of Channel 4 is also stated to be in Toronto.

nodes.name: Disney Channel
nodes.summary: The Disney Channel was the original broadcaster of Girl Meets World. The headquarters of Disney Channel is located in Burbank.
